rv.q: And thus is conjured a very enjoyable, very self-aware, very slick, very tuneful, very constructed-to-please-the-crowds new Broadway musical.

With song and dance numbers like 'Welcome to Diversity Day', 'Goodbye Toby, You're The Worsty' and 'That's What She Said', the send-up combines the asides and straight-to-camera monologues of the TV show's 'mockumentary' style and the razzle-dazzle of musical theater with hilarious results.
Sparkly, silly, wellacted, wellsung, welldanced...and, well, delightful.
